job.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Robotics
job.pay_full: $143,700 – $194,400 a year base salary (Westborough, MA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Amazon Robotics builds the full-stack software that keeps thousands of robots moving across Amazon's fulfillment network. This team owns floor-management workflows, real-time visualization and troubleshooting tools, and maintenance-management platforms used across hundreds of fulfillment sites, with a roadmap focused on autonomous monitoring and intelligent maintenance. Features are tested against live robotic systems, so engineers see the effect of their code quickly.
duties: Architect, design and build distributed systems applications and infrastructure that support robotic movement
Help shape the team's strategy, long-term vision and roadmap
Work with solutions architecture and operations teams to iterate on design and implementation
Keep standards high through reviews, fault-tolerant design and continuous improvement
Prototype and test features in simulation, on emulators and with live robotic equipment
Work with customers and partners to test prototypes and act on feedback
Mentor other engineers on the team
needs: 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years of non-internship design or architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability, scaling)
1+ years as a software development engineer or in a related occupation
1+ years designing and building large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software in C#, C++, Java or Perl
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
nice: 3+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations
details.benefits: Base salary $143,700 – $194,400 a year (Westborough, MA). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
